## Postdoctoral research in membrane-protein biophysics

The legacy group website advertises a **2.5-year postdoctoral position** working on membrane-protein biophysics, with a strong molecular-dynamics component and opportunities to use machine-learning methods.

Candidates should have a documented background in molecular dynamics simulations. A background in physics, chemistry, engineering or a related quantitative discipline is particularly relevant.

Formal positions at SDU are advertised through the University's recruitment system. For research-fit questions, use the contact details on this site; applications should follow the instructions in the official advertisement.

[SDU vacancies](https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu)
